analysis.summary: For the financial year ended March 31, 2026, Nidhi Granites reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs. 6250.44 lakhs and profit after tax of Rs. 766.94 lakhs. Management highlighted that the outlook is promising with the addition of the Fintech business and that the company is likely to grow with accelerated momentum. During the year, wholly-owned subsidiary SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited divested its entire shareholding in Fine Papyrus Private Limited.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the outlook is very promising with the addition of the Fintech business.
guidance.quote: The Company’s performance has been steadily improving and the outlook very promising with the addition of Fintech business.

guidance.claim: The company expects to grow with accelerated momentum in the coming year.
guidance.quote: The Company is likely to grow with accelerated momentum in the coming year.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company to grow with accelerated momentum in the coming year, driven by the addition of the fintech business.
guidance.quote: The Company’s performance has been steadily improving and the outlook very promising with the addition of Fintech business. The Company is likely to grow with accelerated momentum in the coming year.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of leveraging business environment improvements and implementing expense controls to enhance performance.
guidance.quote: The Company is hopeful that it can leverage improvements in the business environment while also implementing expense controls to enhance its performance.

guidance.claim: The company states that making an optimistic prediction for business prospects in the coming year is difficult due to a challenging market environment and stiff competition.
guidance.quote: Given the challenging market environment and stiff competition, it is difficult to make an optimistic prediction for business prospect in the coming year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's business prospects are tied to the local economic environment and escalating geopolitical hostilities.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company’s business prospects are closely linked to the economic environment prevailing locally and escalating geopolitical hostilities.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's business prospects are closely linked to the local and global economic environment.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company’s business prospects are closely linked to the economic environment prevailing locally and globally.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is facing challenges in its core business activities and has started focusing on trading in securities to productively deploy its resources.
demand_outlook.quote: The Company is facing challenges in its core business activities and in order to deploy its resources productively, the Company has started focusing in the business activities pertaining to Trading in securities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has invested in various subsidiaries and is focusing on scaling up their operations.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has been deploying its resources productively; it has invested in various subsidiaries and is focusing on scaling up their operation.

capex_expansion.claim: SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited divested its entire shareholding of 9,90,000 equity shares in Fine Papyrus Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, divested its entire shareholding comprising 9,90,000 equity shares in Fine Papyrus Private Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired 12,500 equity shares of Auro Fintech Private Limited for a consideration of INR 60,57,000 on April 1, 2025, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company acquired 12,500 Equity shares for a consideration of INR 60,57,000 of Auro Fintech Private Limited (CIN: U72900MH2022PTC377921) on 1st April 2025, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired 100% of the equity share capital of Yug Fashion Garment Private Limited for Rs. 1.2 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, on 10th May, 2023, the Company acquired 100% of equity share capital (10,000 equity shares of Rs. 10 each) of Yug Fashion Garment Private Limited from existing shareholders for a consideration of Rs. 1.2 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired an additional 42,30,000 shares under a rights issue by Yug Fashion Garment Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, during the year the Company has acquired 42,30,000 additional shares of Rs. 10 each at face value under right issue by Yug Fashion Garment Private Limited.

margins_costs.claim: The company is implementing expense controls to enhance performance while seeking to leverage business environment improvements.
margins_costs.quote: The Company is hopeful that it can leverage improvements in the business environment while also implementing expense controls to enhance its performance.

orders_capacity.claim: The company did not have any business during the year and cannot ascertain opportunities and threats.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company does not have any business during the year, hence company cannot ascertain any opportunities and threats.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any amount to General Reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not transferred any amount to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors did not recommend a dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: Directors do not recommend any dividend for the current year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company provided a guarantee of ₹5 Crores to its wholly owned subsidiary SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Company has not granted any loans or provided any guarantees or securities, except for a guarantee of ₹5 Crores provided to SPNP Paper and Pack Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 40,00,000 bonus equity shares in a 1:1 ratio to shareholders on May 4, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year the company allotted 40,00,000 bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1 (One) new fully paid‐up equity share of Rs. 10/‐ (Rupees Ten Only) each for every 1 (One) existing fully paid‐up equity share of Rs. 10/‐ (Rupees Ten Only) each to the shareholders of the Company on 4th May, 2024 and the same were listed on Bombay Stock Exchange (“BSE”) on 7th May, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 13,47,805 equity shares upon conversion of warrants on a preferential basis.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, the Company has issued and allotted 13,47,805 Equity shares of face value Rs. 10/‐ each at Rs. 29/‐per share (including premium of Rs. 19/‐ per share) on preferential allotment basis against conversion of share warrants.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 40,00,000 bonus equity shares in a 1:1 proportion.
capital_allocation.quote: b. 40,00,000 bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1 (One) new fully paid‐up equity share of Rs. 10/‐ (Rupees Ten Only) each for every 1 (One) existing fully paid‐up equity share of Rs. 10/‐ (Rupees Ten Only) each to the shareholders of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: Shareholders approved the variation in the utilization of preferential issue proceeds and approved their future utilization for general corporate purposes, investments, loans, or capital assets.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year, the Shareholders of the Company at its Annual General Meeting held on 22nd July, 2023, ratified, and approved the variation in utilisation of proceeds of the preferential issue made by the Company and further approved the future utilisation of the said proceeds for general corporate purpose or for investments or providing loans or creating capital assets in compliance with various laws.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Board noted that there is currently no identifiable risk threatening the existence of the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: At present there is no identifiable risk which, in the opinion, of the Board may threaten the existence of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's business prospects are linked to local economic conditions and escalating geopolitical hostilities.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company’s business prospects are closely linked to the economic environment prevailing locally and escalating geopolitical hostilities.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is facing challenges in its core business activities.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company is facing challenges in its core business activities and in order to deploy its resources productively, the Company has started focusing in the business activities pertaining to Trading in securities.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company notes that managing business risk is an integral part of generating shareholder value.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company recognizes that managing business risk is an integral part of generating substantial and sustainable shareholder value.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to grow with accelerated momentum in the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company is likely to grow with accelerated momentum in the coming year.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company is likely to grow with accelerated momentum in the coming year with the addition of the Fintech business.
management_commitments.quote: The Company’s performance has been steadily improving and the outlook very promising with the addition of Fintech business. The Company is likely to grow with accelerated momentum in the coming year.

management_commitments.claim: The Board proposed to issue bonus equity shares in a 1:1 proportion to shareholders as of the record date of 2nd May, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: The Board at its meeting held on 15th March 2024, subject to the approval of the members, has proposed to issue Bonus Equity shares in the proportion of 1(one) new fully paid‐up equity of Rs. 10/‐ (Rupees Ten) each for every 1(one) existing fully paid‐up Equity shares of Rs. 10/‐ (Rupees Ten) each to the Shareholders of the Company whose name appears in the register as on the record date, that is 2nd May, 2024.

management_commitments.quote: The Company is hopeful that it can leverage improvements in the business environment while also implementing expense controls to enhance its performance.
